evals.name: text-poster
evals.prompt: Generate a movie poster with exact text: a 2.35:1 ultra-wide poster, centered title typography reading EXACT, VERBATIM, NO EXTRA CHARACTERS 'AURORA 2026' in bold condensed sans-serif (Helvetica Condensed style), subtitle in italic serif 'A short film by Lin Wei'. Use a deep navy background with a single gold accent. Letter-by-letter A-U-R-O-R-A for the title to ensure spelling. No other text anywhere.
evals.expected_output: A 2.35:1 wide PNG (1792x1024) saved to output/gpt-image-2/aurora-poster.png with a sibling .json metadata file. The title 'AURORA 2026' should be legible and correctly spelled, and the subtitle should be present.

assertions.name: image file is created
assertions.description: An output file matching *aurora-poster*.png exists in output/gpt-image-2/

assertions.name: image is 2.35:1 wide
assertions.description: The output image's aspect ratio is approximately 2.35:1 (wider than tall)

assertions.name: metadata JSON is written
assertions.description: A .json file with the same stem exists, containing prompt, model, and size

assertions.name: model is gpt-image-2
assertions.description: The metadata.json shows model = gpt-image-2 (not gpt-image-1.5 or gpt-image-1)

assertions.name: size is wide preset
assertions.description: The metadata.json shows size in {1792x1024, auto} (matching the --size wide preset or auto fallback)

evals.name: product-edit
evals.prompt: I have a product photo at /tmp/eval-fixtures/product.png (a 1024x1024 ceramic mug on a white background). Edit it: replace ONLY the background with a warm sunset gradient. Keep the product, the product edges, the lighting on the product, and the camera angle UNCHANGED. No text, no logos, no watermark. Output to output/gpt-image-2/mug-sunset.png.
evals.expected_output: A 1024x1024 (or larger) PNG with the mug intact and a warm gradient background. Metadata JSON notes the reference image path.

assertions.name: image file is created
assertions.description: An output file matching *mug-sunset*.png exists in output/gpt-image-2/

assertions.name: metadata references the input image
assertions.description: The .json metadata lists reference_images including the product.png path

assertions.name: endpoint is /v1/images/edits
assertions.description: Either the dry-run payload or the request flow used the edits endpoint, not generations

assertions.name: edit command was used
assertions.description: The CLI was invoked with `edit`, not `generate`

evals.name: batch-variants
evals.prompt: Generate three variants for a product card series from /tmp/eval-fixtures/batch-prompts.jsonl: 1) a vintage travel poster with EXACT verbatim text 'KYOTO SPRING' (letter-by-letter K-Y-O-T-O S-P-R-I-N-G) in square format at high quality, 2) a studio shot of a fountain pen in portrait at medium quality, 3) a flat 3D low-poly arctic fox in square. Output to output/gpt-image-2/batch/.
evals.expected_output: Three PNG files in output/gpt-image-2/batch/, each with a sibling .json metadata file. The KYOTO SPRING poster's title should be spelled correctly.

assertions.name: three output images are created
assertions.description: output/gpt-image-2/batch/ contains three .png files (one per job) plus metadata .json

assertions.name: sizes match per-job overrides
assertions.description: The metadata .json files record square / portrait / square as the size

assertions.name: qualities match per-job overrides
assertions.description: The metadata .json files record high / medium / auto (or unset) qualities

assertions.name: metadata is consistent across the batch
assertions.description: All three .json files share the same model and base_url
